title: A scalar model as normalized derived extension data
statement:
Every normalized SystemScalarModel for a sheaf-ring map gives SystemDerivedLeftExtension data for its actual scalar restriction functor and the independent K-flat resolving predicate, retaining its ordinary tensor functor, ordinary adjunction, derived tensor functor, comparison, and normalized Hom transpose.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
def systemScalarModelExtension {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}} {φ : R ⟶ S}
    (A : SystemScalarModel φ) :
    SystemDerivedLeftExtension
      (restrictScalars.{w} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map φ))
      (CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R))
```

proof.text: Fill the record using the scalar model and its universal left derived property. The existing resolving-class theorem supplies pointwise existence and an exact triangulated model; uniqueness of the universal left derived comparison transfers shift and triangulated data to the chosen tensor model. The remaining normalization is the scalar model transpose formula.
